Snakebites are serious, but a clear first response matters. This small guide brings together the essential ideas: recognize the danger, keep the person still, and seek emergency medical care quickly.

:::

::: {.quick-facts}
### If a bite happens

1. Move away from the snake and keep calm.
2. Call local emergency services immediately.
3. Keep the person and the affected limb as still as possible.
4. Do not cut the wound, suck out venom, or apply a tourniquet.
:::

::: {.bite-estimate}
### A 20-year global estimate

The World Health Organization estimates that **5.4 million people are bitten by snakes worldwide each year**. If that annual estimate stayed constant, approximately **108 million bites** would occur over 20 years.

This is a population-level estimate, not a count for the selected species. The WHO also estimates 1.8 to 2.7 million envenomings and 81,410 to 137,880 deaths each year.

[Read the WHO fact sheet](https://www.who.int/news-room/fact-sheets/detail/snakebite-envenoming)
:::

## Read the signs

Pain, swelling, puncture marks, bruising, weakness, nausea, or trouble breathing can all be warning signs. Symptoms may change over time, so medical evaluation is important even when the bite looks small.

::: {.callout-warning}
## Important

This website is educational and is not a substitute for emergency care. Never try to catch or handle the snake. If someone has been bitten, contact emergency services or a poison center now.
:::

<script>
let snakeRecords = [];
const commonNameLookup = new Map();

const familyByGenus = {
	Acanthophis: "Elapidae", Aipysurus: "Elapidae", Bungarus: "Elapidae", Dendroaspis: "Elapidae",
	Laticauda: "Elapidae", Micruroides: "Elapidae", Naja: "Elapidae", Oxyuranus: "Elapidae",
	Pseudohaje: "Elapidae", Sinomicrurus: "Elapidae", Walterinnesia: "Elapidae",
	Acrochordus: "Acrochordidae", Anilius: "Aniliidae", Antaresia: "Pythonidae", Apodora: "Pythonidae",
	Aspidites: "Pythonidae", Bothrochilus: "Pythonidae", Liasis: "Pythonidae", Morelia: "Pythonidae",
	Python: "Pythonidae", Simalia: "Pythonidae", Boa: "Boidae", Corallus: "Boidae",
	Eunectes: "Boidae", Eryx: "Boidae", Epicrates: "Boidae", Candoia: "Boidae",
	Agkistrodon: "Viperidae", Atheris: "Viperidae", Bitis: "Viperidae", Bothriechis: "Viperidae",
	Bothrops: "Viperidae", Crotalus: "Viperidae", Lachesis: "Viperidae", Sistrurus: "Viperidae",
	Trimeresurus: "Viperidae", Vipera: "Viperidae", Ahaetulla: "Colubridae", Boiga: "Colubridae",
	Dipsas: "Colubridae", Elaphe: "Colubridae", Lampropeltis: "Colubridae", Pantherophis: "Colubridae",
	Pituophis: "Colubridae", Rhinobothryum: "Colubridae", Spalerosophis: "Colubridae",
	Amphiesma: "Natricidae", Natrix: "Natricidae", Nerodia: "Natricidae", Rhabdophis: "Natricidae",
	Thamnophis: "Natricidae", Acutotyphlops: "Typhlopidae", Anilios: "Typhlopidae", Amerotyphlops: "Typhlopidae",
	Rhinotyphlops: "Typhlopidae", Xenopeltis: "Xenopeltidae", Bolyeria: "Bolyeriidae", Casarea: "Bolyeriidae"
};

function normalizeText(value) {
	return String(value || "").toLowerCase().normalize("NFD").replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "");
}

function clamp(value, min, max) {
	return Math.min(Math.max(value, min), max);
}

function parseCsv(text) {
	const rows = [];
	let row = [], field = "", quoted = false;
	for (let index = 0; index < text.length; index += 1) {
		const character = text[index];
		const next = text[index + 1];
		if (character === '"' && quoted && next === '"') {
			field += '"';
			index += 1;
		} else if (character === '"') {
			quoted = !quoted;
		} else if (character === "," && !quoted) {
			row.push(field);
			field = "";
		} else if ((character === "\n" || character === "\r") && !quoted) {
			if (character === "\r" && next === "\n") index += 1;
			row.push(field);
			if (row.length === 3 && row[0] !== "species") rows.push({ species: row[0], url: row[2] });
			row = [];
			field = "";
		} else {
			field += character;
		}
	}
	return rows;
}

async function lookupCommonName(record) {
	const key = record.species;
	if (commonNameLookup.has(key)) return commonNameLookup.get(key);
	try {
		const response = await fetch(`https://api.inaturalist.org/v1/taxa?q=${encodeURIComponent(record.species)}&rank=species&per_page=1`);
		if (!response.ok) throw new Error("Lookup failed");
		const data = await response.json();
		const value = data.results?.[0]?.preferred_common_name || "";
		commonNameLookup.set(key, value);
		return value;
	} catch {
		commonNameLookup.set(key, "");
		return "";
	}
}

const galaxySearchInput = document.querySelector("#galaxy-search");
const galaxySearchButton = document.querySelector("#galaxy-search-btn");
const galaxyResetButton = document.querySelector("#galaxy-reset-view");
const galaxyZoomInButton = document.querySelector("#galaxy-zoom-in");
const galaxyZoomOutButton = document.querySelector("#galaxy-zoom-out");
const galaxyViewport = document.querySelector("#galaxy-viewport");
const galaxySvg = document.querySelector("#galaxy-svg");
const galaxyTransform = document.querySelector("#galaxy-transform");
const galaxyLinksLayer = document.querySelector("#galaxy-links");
const galaxyNodesLayer = document.querySelector("#galaxy-nodes");
const galaxyFamilyPill = document.querySelector("#galaxy-family-pill");
const galaxyGenusPill = document.querySelector("#galaxy-genus-pill");
const galaxySpeciesName = document.querySelector("#galaxy-species-name");
const galaxyCommonName = document.querySelector("#galaxy-common-name");
const galaxyImageWrap = document.querySelector("#galaxy-image-wrap");
const galaxyImage = document.querySelector("#galaxy-species-image");
const galaxyImageCredit = document.querySelector("#galaxy-image-credit");
const galaxyFamilyMeta = document.querySelector("#galaxy-family-meta");
const galaxyGenusMeta = document.querySelector("#galaxy-genus-meta");
const galaxyScientificMeta = document.querySelector("#galaxy-scientific-meta");
const galaxyLink = document.querySelector("#galaxy-link");
const galaxyEmpty = document.querySelector("#galaxy-empty");
const galaxyCard = document.querySelector("#galaxy-card");

const galaxyState = {
	zoom: 1,
	x: 0,
	y: 0,
	min: 0.55,
	max: 1.8,
	selectedFamily: null,
	selectedGenus: null,
	selectedSpecies: null,
	genusPositions: new Map(),
}

function applyGalaxyTransform() {
	galaxyTransform.setAttribute("transform", `translate(${galaxyState.x} ${galaxyState.y}) scale(${galaxyState.zoom})`);
}

function resetGalaxyView() {
	galaxyState.zoom = 1;
	galaxyState.x = 0;
	galaxyState.y = 0;
	applyGalaxyTransform();
}

function zoomGalaxy(delta) {
	const nextZoom = clamp(galaxyState.zoom + delta, galaxyState.min, galaxyState.max);
	const rect = galaxyViewport.getBoundingClientRect();
	const centerX = rect.width / 2;
	const centerY = rect.height / 2;
	const ratio = nextZoom / galaxyState.zoom;
	galaxyState.x = (galaxyState.x - centerX) * ratio + centerX;
	galaxyState.y = (galaxyState.y - centerY) * ratio + centerY;
	galaxyState.zoom = nextZoom;
	applyGalaxyTransform();
}

let galaxyDrag = null;

galaxyViewport.addEventListener("pointerdown", (event) => {
	if (event.target.closest(".galaxy-node-group")) return;
	galaxyDrag = {
		pointerId: event.pointerId,
		startX: event.clientX,
		startY: event.clientY,
		originX: galaxyState.x,
		originY: galaxyState.y,
	};
	galaxyViewport.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
});

galaxyViewport.addEventListener("pointermove", (event) => {
	if (!galaxyDrag || galaxyDrag.pointerId !== event.pointerId) return;
	galaxyState.x = galaxyDrag.originX + (event.clientX - galaxyDrag.startX);
	galaxyState.y = galaxyDrag.originY + (event.clientY - galaxyDrag.startY);
	applyGalaxyTransform();
});

galaxyViewport.addEventListener("pointerup", (event) => {
	if (galaxyDrag && galaxyDrag.pointerId === event.pointerId) galaxyDrag = null;
});

galaxyViewport.addEventListener("pointerleave", () => {
	galaxyDrag = null;
});

galaxyViewport.addEventListener("wheel", (event) => {
	event.preventDefault();
	zoomGalaxy(event.deltaY < 0 ? 0.12 : -0.12);
}, { passive: false });

galaxyResetButton.addEventListener("click", resetGalaxyView);
galaxyZoomInButton.addEventListener("click", () => zoomGalaxy(0.2));
galaxyZoomOutButton.addEventListener("click", () => zoomGalaxy(-0.2));

galaxySearchButton.addEventListener("click", () => {
	const query = normalizeText(galaxySearchInput.value.trim());
	if (!query) return;
	const matches = [];
	for (const record of snakeRecords) {
		const [genus] = record.species.split(/\s+/, 2);
		const family = familyByGenus[genus] || "Family not available in source";
		const searchText = [family, genus, record.species].map(normalizeText).join(" ");
		if (searchText.includes(query)) matches.push({ record, family, genus });
	}
	if (!matches.length) return;
	const chosen = matches[0];
	selectGalaxyNode(chosen.family, chosen.genus, chosen.record.species, chosen.record);
});

galaxySearchInput.addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
	if (event.key === "Enter") galaxySearchButton.click();
});

function setGalaxySelectionState(family, genus, species) {
	galaxyState.selectedFamily = family || null;
	galaxyState.selectedGenus = genus || null;
	galaxyState.selectedSpecies = species || null;
}

function buildGalaxyGraph() {
	const families = new Map();
	for (const record of snakeRecords) {
		const [genus, species] = record.species.split(/\s+/, 2);
		const family = familyByGenus[genus] || "Family not available in source";
		if (!families.has(family)) families.set(family, new Map());
		const genera = families.get(family);
		if (!genera.has(genus)) genera.set(genus, []);
		genera.get(genus).push(record);
	}

	const familyNames = [...families.keys()].sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b));
	const center = { x: 500, y: 350 };
	const familyRadius = 185;

	galaxyLinksLayer.innerHTML = "";
	galaxyNodesLayer.innerHTML = "";
	galaxyState.genusPositions.clear();

	const rootNode = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "g");
	rootNode.setAttribute("class", "galaxy-node-group");
	rootNode.setAttribute("data-type", "root");
	rootNode.setAttribute("data-selected", "true");
	rootNode.setAttribute("transform", `translate(${center.x} ${center.y})`);
	const rootCircle = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "circle");
	rootCircle.setAttribute("class", "galaxy-node-core");
	rootCircle.setAttribute("r", "42");
	rootCircle.setAttribute("cx", "0");
	rootCircle.setAttribute("cy", "0");
	rootNode.appendChild(rootCircle);
	const rootText = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "text");
	rootText.setAttribute("class", "galaxy-node-label");
	rootText.setAttribute("x", "0");
	rootText.setAttribute("y", "4");
	rootText.textContent = "Snakes";
	rootNode.appendChild(rootText);
	rootNode.addEventListener("click", () => {
		setGalaxySelectionState(null, null, null);
		buildGalaxyGraph();
		galaxyEmpty.hidden = false;
		galaxyCard.hidden = true;
	});
	galaxyNodesLayer.appendChild(rootNode);

	familyNames.forEach((family, index) => {
		const angle = (Math.PI * 2 * index) / familyNames.length - Math.PI / 2;
		const familyX = center.x + Math.cos(angle) * familyRadius;
		const familyY = center.y + Math.sin(angle) * familyRadius;
		const familyNode = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "g");
		familyNode.setAttribute("class", "galaxy-node-group");
		familyNode.setAttribute("data-type", "family");
		familyNode.setAttribute("transform", `translate(${familyX} ${familyY})`);
		familyNode.setAttribute("data-family", family);
		const line = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "path");
		line.setAttribute("class", "galaxy-link");
		line.dataset.family = family;
		line.setAttribute("d", `M ${center.x} ${center.y} L ${familyX} ${familyY}`);
		galaxyLinksLayer.appendChild(line);
		const familyCircle = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "circle");
		familyCircle.setAttribute("class", "galaxy-node-core");
		familyCircle.setAttribute("r", "23");
		familyCircle.setAttribute("cx", "0");
		familyCircle.setAttribute("cy", "0");
		familyNode.appendChild(familyCircle);
		const familyText = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "text");
		familyText.setAttribute("class", "galaxy-node-label");
		familyText.setAttribute("x", "0");
		familyText.setAttribute("y", "4");
		familyText.textContent = family;
		familyNode.appendChild(familyText);
		familyNode.addEventListener("click", () => {
			setGalaxySelectionState(family, null, null);
			buildGalaxyGraph();
			galaxyEmpty.hidden = false;
			galaxyCard.hidden = true;
		});
		galaxyNodesLayer.appendChild(familyNode);

		const genera = [...families.get(family).keys()]
			.sort((left, right) => families.get(family).get(right).length - families.get(family).get(left).length)
			.slice(0, 4);
		if (!galaxyState.selectedFamily || galaxyState.selectedFamily !== family) return;
		genera.forEach((genus, genusIndex) => {
			const genusOffset = (Math.PI * 2 * genusIndex) / Math.max(genera.length, 1) - Math.PI / 2;
			const genusX = familyX + Math.cos(genusOffset) * 90;
			const genusY = familyY + Math.sin(genusOffset) * 90;
			galaxyState.genusPositions.set(`${family}::${genus}`, { x: genusX, y: genusY });
			const genusNode = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "g");
			genusNode.setAttribute("class", "galaxy-node-group");
			genusNode.setAttribute("data-type", "genus");
			genusNode.setAttribute("transform", `translate(${genusX} ${genusY})`);
			genusNode.setAttribute("data-family", family);
			genusNode.setAttribute("data-genus", genus);
			const genusLine = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "path");
			genusLine.setAttribute("class", "galaxy-link");
			genusLine.dataset.family = family;
			genusLine.dataset.genus = genus;
			genusLine.setAttribute("d", `M ${familyX} ${familyY} L ${genusX} ${genusY}`);
			galaxyLinksLayer.appendChild(genusLine);
			const genusCircle = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "circle");
			genusCircle.setAttribute("class", "galaxy-node-core");
			genusCircle.setAttribute("r", "14");
			genusCircle.setAttribute("cx", "0");
			genusCircle.setAttribute("cy", "0");
			genusNode.appendChild(genusCircle);
			const genusText = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "text");
			genusText.setAttribute("class", "galaxy-node-label");
			genusText.setAttribute("x", "0");
			genusText.setAttribute("y", "3");
			genusText.textContent = genus;
			genusNode.appendChild(genusText);
			genusNode.addEventListener("click", () => {
				const sample = families.get(family).get(genus)[0];
				selectGalaxyNode(family, genus, sample.species, sample, false);
			});
			galaxyNodesLayer.appendChild(genusNode);

		});
	});

	updateGalaxyEmphasis();
}

function renderGalaxySpecies(family, genus, selectedSpecies) {
	document.querySelectorAll('.galaxy-node-group[data-type="species"], .galaxy-link[data-type="species"]').forEach((node) => node.remove());
	const position = galaxyState.genusPositions.get(`${family}::${genus}`);
	const records = snakeRecords
		.filter((record) => record.species.split(/\s+/, 1)[0] === genus)
		.sort((left, right) => left.species.localeCompare(right.species));
	const selectedRecord = records.find((record) => record.species === selectedSpecies);
	const visibleRecords = records.filter((record) => record !== selectedRecord).slice(0, 11);
	if (selectedRecord) visibleRecords.unshift(selectedRecord);
	if (!position) return;

	visibleRecords.forEach((record, index) => {
		const angle = (Math.PI * 2 * index) / Math.max(visibleRecords.length, 1) - Math.PI / 2;
		const speciesX = position.x + Math.cos(angle) * 76;
		const speciesY = position.y + Math.sin(angle) * 76;
		const speciesNode = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "g");
		speciesNode.setAttribute("class", "galaxy-node-group");
		speciesNode.setAttribute("data-type", "species");
		speciesNode.setAttribute("transform", `translate(${speciesX} ${speciesY})`);
		speciesNode.dataset.family = family;
		speciesNode.dataset.genus = genus;
		speciesNode.dataset.species = record.species;
		const speciesLine = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "path");
		speciesLine.setAttribute("class", "galaxy-link");
		speciesLine.dataset.type = "species";
		speciesLine.dataset.family = family;
		speciesLine.dataset.genus = genus;
		speciesLine.dataset.species = record.species;
		speciesLine.setAttribute("d", `M ${position.x} ${position.y} L ${speciesX} ${speciesY}`);
		galaxyLinksLayer.appendChild(speciesLine);
		const speciesCircle = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "circle");
		speciesCircle.setAttribute("class", "galaxy-node-core");
		speciesCircle.setAttribute("r", "7");
		speciesNode.appendChild(speciesCircle);
		const speciesText = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "text");
		speciesText.setAttribute("class", "galaxy-node-label");
		speciesText.setAttribute("x", "0");
		speciesText.setAttribute("y", "3");
		speciesText.textContent = record.species;
		speciesNode.appendChild(speciesText);
		speciesNode.addEventListener("click", () => selectGalaxyNode(family, genus, record.species, record));
		galaxyNodesLayer.appendChild(speciesNode);
	});
}

function updateGalaxyEmphasis() {
	const allGroups = [...document.querySelectorAll(".galaxy-node-group")];
	const allLinks = [...document.querySelectorAll(".galaxy-link")];
	galaxyViewport.classList.toggle("has-selection", Boolean(galaxyState.selectedSpecies));

	allGroups.forEach((group) => {
		const family = group.dataset.family;
		const genus = group.dataset.genus;
		const species = group.dataset.species;
		const isRoot = group.dataset.type === "root";
		const matchesFamily = galaxyState.selectedFamily && family === galaxyState.selectedFamily;
		const matchesGenus = galaxyState.selectedGenus && genus === galaxyState.selectedGenus;
		const matchesSpecies = galaxyState.selectedSpecies && species === galaxyState.selectedSpecies;
		const isRelated = isRoot || matchesFamily || matchesGenus || matchesSpecies || !galaxyState.selectedFamily;
		const isCurrentSpecies = matchesSpecies;
		group.classList.toggle("is-muted", !isRelated && !isRoot);
		group.classList.toggle("is-emphasized", matchesFamily || matchesGenus || matchesSpecies || isRoot);
		group.classList.toggle("is-current", isCurrentSpecies);
		group.setAttribute("data-selected", String(matchesFamily || matchesGenus || matchesSpecies || isRoot));
	});

	allLinks.forEach((link) => {
		const shouldHighlight = Boolean(galaxyState.selectedFamily)
			&& (link.dataset.family === galaxyState.selectedFamily
			|| link.dataset.genus === galaxyState.selectedGenus
			|| link.dataset.species === galaxyState.selectedSpecies);
		link.classList.toggle("is-muted", !shouldHighlight && galaxyState.selectedFamily);
		link.classList.toggle("is-emphasized", shouldHighlight);
	});
}

async function loadGalaxySpeciesImage(record, family, genus) {
	const cleanName = record.species;
	try {
		const response = await fetch(`https://api.inaturalist.org/v1/taxa?q=${encodeURIComponent(cleanName)}&rank=species&per_page=1`);
		if (!response.ok) throw new Error("Image not found");
		const data = await response.json();
		const photo = data.results?.[0]?.default_photo;
		if (!photo?.medium_url) throw new Error("Image missing");
		galaxyImage.src = photo.medium_url;
		galaxyImage.alt = `iNaturalist image of ${cleanName}`;
		galaxyImageCredit.textContent = photo.attribution || "Image from iNaturalist";
		galaxyImageWrap.hidden = false;
	} catch {
		galaxyImageWrap.hidden = true;
		galaxyImageCredit.textContent = "";
	}
}

function selectGalaxyNode(family, genus, speciesName, record, focusSpecies = true, revealFamily = false) {
	setGalaxySelectionState(family, genus, focusSpecies ? speciesName : null);
	if (revealFamily || !galaxyState.genusPositions.has(`${family}::${genus}`)) buildGalaxyGraph();
	const visibleSpeciesNode = [...document.querySelectorAll('.galaxy-node-group[data-type="species"]')]
		.find((node) => node.dataset.species === speciesName);
	if (!focusSpecies || !visibleSpeciesNode) {
		renderGalaxySpecies(family, genus, focusSpecies ? speciesName : null);
	}
	updateGalaxyEmphasis();
	galaxyEmpty.hidden = true;
	galaxyCard.hidden = false;
	galaxyFamilyPill.textContent = family;
	galaxyGenusPill.textContent = genus;
	const [genusName, speciesPart] = speciesName.split(/\s+/, 2);
	galaxySpeciesName.textContent = speciesName;
	galaxyFamilyMeta.textContent = family;
	galaxyGenusMeta.textContent = genus;
	galaxyScientificMeta.textContent = speciesName;
	galaxyCommonName.textContent = "Loading common name...";
	galaxyLink.href = record.url;
	loadGalaxySpeciesImage(record, family, genus).then(async () => {
		const common = await lookupCommonName(record);
		galaxyCommonName.textContent = common ? `Common name: ${common}` : "Common name: not available";
	});
}

fetch("data/snakes-search-results.csv")
	.then((response) => response.text())
	.then((text) => {
		snakeRecords = parseCsv(text);
		buildGalaxyGraph();
		applyGalaxyTransform();
	})
	.catch(() => {
		galaxyEmpty.innerHTML = "<p>The taxonomy galaxy could not be loaded from the source dataset.</p>";
	});
</script>
